data_split.train_start: Start date for causal discovery training period (YYYYMMDD). Causal graph is learned ONLY from this period.
data_split.train_end: End date for causal discovery training period (YYYYMMDD, inclusive).
data_split.test_start: Start date for out-of-sample backtest period (YYYYMMDD). Backtest and invariance testing use this period.
data_split.test_end: End date for out-of-sample backtest period (YYYYMMDD, inclusive).

pandadata.indicator: Default stock universe index for PandaData. 000300=CSI 300, 000905=CSI 500, 000016=SSE 50, 000852=CSI 1000.
pandadata.exclude_st: If true, exclude ST (special treatment) stocks from the universe.

causal_discovery.method: Causal discovery method: 'pc', 'lingam', 'notears', or 'hybrid' (recommended). Hybrid runs PC for skeleton, LiNGAM for ordering and effect estimation, NOTEARS as fallback for high dimensions.
causal_discovery.pc_alpha: Significance level for conditional independence tests in PC algorithm. Lower = sparser graph, fewer false edges.
causal_discovery.pc_max_cond_set: Maximum size of conditioning set in PC algorithm. Higher = more thorough but exponentially slower.
causal_discovery.lingam_prune_threshold: Minimum absolute coefficient for LiNGAM to retain an edge. Higher = sparser DAG.
causal_discovery.notears_lambda1: L1 regularization strength for NOTEARS. Higher = sparser DAG.
causal_discovery.notears_threshold: Minimum absolute weight for NOTEARS to retain an edge after optimization.
causal_discovery.bootstrap_runs: Number of bootstrap resamples for stability scoring. Higher = more reliable but slower.
causal_discovery.bootstrap_stability_threshold: Minimum fraction of bootstrap runs an edge must appear in to be considered stable.
causal_discovery.min_obs_per_stock: Minimum trading days required per stock to be included in causal discovery.
causal_discovery.diversity_max_per_family: Maximum components allowed from the same signal family (e.g., amt_cv_40d and amt_cv_60d are same family). Set to 1 to avoid near-duplicate features differing only in lookback window. Used by ic_selection method.

target.forward_return_days: Horizon (in trading days) for forward return prediction target.
target.alternative_horizons: Additional horizons to test causal edges against, for robustness.

feature_generation.families: Feature families to generate from OHLCV data: momentum, volatility, volume_flow, price_pattern, cross_family.
feature_generation.max_features_per_family: Maximum features to generate per family.
feature_generation.max_total_features: Hard cap on total generated features.
feature_generation.min_rolling_window: Minimum window length for rolling/time-series functions.
feature_generation.max_rolling_window: Maximum window length for rolling/time-series functions.

invariance_testing.n_regimes: Number of distinct market regimes to identify for invariance testing.
invariance_testing.regime_method: Method for regime identification: 'volatility_clustering' (by vol level), 'return_quantiles' (bull/bear), 'calendar_year' (by year), or 'all' (runs all three independently and compares).
invariance_testing.min_regime_obs: Minimum observations per regime to include in invariance test.
invariance_testing.homogeneity_alpha: Significance level for χ² test of ATE homogeneity across regimes.
invariance_testing.stability_required_regimes: Fraction of regimes where an edge must be present to be considered invariant.

alpha_construction.min_stability_for_inclusion: Minimum bootstrap stability for a causal parent to be included in the final alpha.
alpha_construction.max_components: Maximum number of causal components in the final alpha expression (controls complexity).
alpha_construction.weight_method: How to weight components: 'ate_times_stability' (ATE × stability score) or 'ate_only' or 'equal'.
alpha_construction.cross_sectional_rank: If true, apply cross-sectional rank normalization to final factor.

backtest._note: All backtesting is done by the built-in standalone engine in integrate_backtest.py. No external skill dependency.
backtest.holding_days: Number of trading days between rebalance events.
